Location Access Required

Mandatory to find societies & services near you

Device Location (GPS) is turned off or blocked. Please enable Location services to continue using TynTron.
How to turn on Location:
1 Swipe down top menu & turn ON Location / GPS
2 Tap Allow when your mobile prompts for permission
Still not working? Click for App/Browser settings instructions
Android Phone: Settings → Apps → TynTron (or Chrome) → Permissions → Location → Select "Allow while using app".
iPhone (iOS): Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services → Turn ON → Select TynTron / Safari.
